issue.title: Split the suite-cost subprocess bucket into deliberate process-boundary tests and avoidable CLI round-trips
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-ib.4 (epic sase-ib) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and forwarded by sase-ib.land while closing that epic.

PROBLEM: the cost harness attributes every subprocess call in the suite to two flat buckets. tests/_test_cost_plugin.py::_patch_subprocess wraps subprocess.run and subprocess.Popen wholesale and records them as the causes 'subprocess_run' and 'subprocess_popen' (labelled in tests/_test_cost.py). Those buckets mix two populations with opposite meanings: deliberate process-boundary coverage (git invocations, nested pytest runs, generated-gate execution, argv/exit-code/signal tests) that must stay a real subprocess, and avoidable CLI round-trips where a test spawns the sase CLI only to assert on stdout and an exit code. sase-ib.4 converted a batch of the second kind to in-process calls but never established the named set of the first kind that its own plan asked for, so the single 'subprocess_run' budget in tests/perf/baselines/test_cost_budgets.json (limit 300.0s) cannot distinguish 'someone added a legitimate process-boundary test' from 'someone reintroduced an avoidable CLI round-trip'. The metric is therefore too coarse to act on: it can only be exceeded, never diagnosed.

SCOPE: decide and implement the classification (a pytest marker on deliberate process-boundary tests is the obvious candidate, since the plugin already sees the running node), attribute the two populations to separate causes in tests/_test_cost.py and tests/_test_cost_plugin.py, split the committed budget accordingly in tests/perf/baselines/test_cost_budgets.json, and document the rule in docs/perf_runbook.md so a new test's author knows which bucket they are landing in. Record the named deliberate set that sase-ib.4's plan called for.

VERIFY: 'just test-cost' produces the two separate causes with numbers that sum to today's combined bucket, and 'tools/check_test_cost_budgets' fails when an avoidable CLI round-trip is reintroduced into a hot file while the deliberate set is unchanged.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ib — this task is the follow-up phase sase-ib.4 proposed while building that epic's cost harness; the harness, its budgets, and tools/check_test_cost_budgets all landed under sase-ib and are the files this task edits.
